{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
customer_segment_conversion = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = customer_segment_conversion.index[0]

# Print the conversion rates for all segments to verify
print(customer_segment_conversion)

# Return the highest segment
highest_conversion_segment"}
